new_written_results.name: identity_numbering_barrier
new_written_results.statement: Full equation induction is not admissible over numeral-equation induction, computations, coverage, separation, successor injectivity, identity iteration, all fixed-standard-seed successor numbering laws, and body extensionality.
new_written_results.bi_interpretability_obstruction: An equivariant model with a nontrivial involution excludes parameter-free bi-interpretability with iPRA, also allowing standard-numeral parameters and definable tuple/quotient domains.
new_written_results.limitation: Arbitrary nonstandard parameters are not excluded by this model argument.

new_written_results.name: fusion_barrier
new_written_results.statement: Full iterator fusion with numeral-equation induction, computations, coverage, separation, successor injectivity, identity iteration and body extensionality does not imply I(n,0;u.Su)=n.
new_written_results.bi_interpretability_obstruction: The model has a nontrivial involution fixing any finite parameter tuple; it excludes first-order bi-interpretability with iPRA even with finite parameters and definable tuple/quotient domains.

positive_equivalence.statement: Over intuitionistic equality logic, computation, coverage and separation, equation induction is equivalent to Fusion plus I(n,0;u.Su)=n.
positive_equivalence.dependency: The pinned article's written arbitrary-update uniqueness theorem kern:thm:ur; its converse is not Lean-formalized there.

tests.scope: Finite regression and framing evidence for unchanged incumbent programs, not a proof of the new infinite models.
